title: Undertow and Inventory
author: Felix Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Okonkwo, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
